✨ ARISE RAGNAROK — Your Journey Starts Here

Welcome to Arise Ragnarok, an anime-inspired RPG that evolves constantly, with bi-weekly updates bringing new content, systems, and progression.

🔥 What you’ll find inside:
🔄 Bi-Weekly Updates (every 15 days)
🎉 Special Events with exclusive rewards
⛏️ Mining System & gear upgrades
⚔️ PvP Battles
🐉 PvE Quests & Creatures
🕳️ Dungeons with rare drops
🧙 Classes & 🧬 Races
💱 Trading System & player economy
🌌 New Arcs, bosses, and systems coming soon

Everything is built side by side with the community.
Your feedback shapes the future of the game.
